metrics.label: QB composite
metrics.desc: Gridiron QB composite: EPA per dropback, CPOE, sack avoidance and turnover-worthy plays, each stabilisation-shrunk, on a 100 = average, 10 = one SD scale (our qb model; a blend of the same components when it is not available).

metrics.label: Composite forecast
metrics.desc: Our QB composite in its own unit: the forecast of next season's EPA per dropback from this season's stabilisation-shrunk components (null when the model is not available).

metrics.label: Gridiron Value
metrics.desc: Expected points added credited to the player, adjusted for opponent and supporting cast (our player_value; raw EPA credit when the model is not available).

metrics.label: EPA / dropback
metrics.desc: Expected points added per dropback (passes, sacks and scrambles).

metrics.label: EPA / play
metrics.desc: EPA per dropback or designed run.

metrics.label: Total EPA
metrics.desc: EPA summed over dropbacks and designed runs.

metrics.label: Success rate
metrics.desc: Share of dropbacks with positive EPA.

metrics.label: CPOE
metrics.desc: Completion percentage over expected, in percentage points (our completion model; nflfastR's cp when ours is not ready).

metrics.label: Completion %
metrics.desc: Completions per attempt.

metrics.label: aDOT
metrics.desc: Average depth of target (air yards per attempt).

metrics.label: Deep rate
metrics.desc: Share of attempts 20+ air yards downfield.

metrics.label: Time to throw
metrics.desc: NGS average time from snap to throw (seconds).

metrics.label: Aggressiveness
metrics.desc: NGS share of attempts into tight windows (a defender within one yard).

metrics.label: Sack rate
metrics.desc: Sacks per dropback.

metrics.label: Pressure rate
metrics.desc: Share of dropbacks under pressure (participation data 2016-2025; our pressure model otherwise).

metrics.label: EPA under pressure
metrics.desc: EPA per dropback when pressured.

metrics.label: EPA clean pocket
metrics.desc: EPA per dropback when not pressured.

metrics.label: Play-action rate
metrics.desc: Share of dropbacks with play action (FTN charting, 2022 onward).

metrics.label: EPA on play action
metrics.desc: EPA per play-action dropback (FTN).

metrics.label: EPA without play action
metrics.desc: EPA per dropback without play action (FTN).

metrics.label: Scramble rate
metrics.desc: Scrambles per dropback.

metrics.label: Scramble EPA
metrics.desc: EPA summed over scrambles.

metrics.label: Designed-run EPA
metrics.desc: EPA summed over designed QB runs (sneaks included).

metrics.label: INT rate
metrics.desc: Interceptions per attempt.

metrics.label: Turnover-worthy rate
metrics.desc: FTN interception-worthy throws per attempt (2022 onward).

metrics.label: Attempts
metrics.desc: Pass attempts.

metrics.label: Passing yards
metrics.desc: Passing yards.

metrics.label: Passing TD
metrics.desc: Passing touchdowns.

metrics.label: Interceptions
metrics.desc: Interceptions thrown.

metrics.label: ANY/A
metrics.desc: Adjusted net yards per attempt: (yards + 20 TD - 45 INT - sack yards) / (attempts + sacks).

metrics.label: EPA / carry
metrics.desc: EPA per designed run.

metrics.label: Rush success
metrics.desc: Share of carries with positive EPA.

metrics.label: RYOE / carry
metrics.desc: Rush yards over expected per carry (our rushing model; NGS RYOE 2016 onward when ours is not ready).

metrics.label: Yards / carry
metrics.desc: Rushing yards per carry.

metrics.label: Explosive rate
metrics.desc: Carries of 10+ yards.

metrics.label: Stuff rate
metrics.desc: Carries for no gain or a loss.

metrics.label: 8+ in box
metrics.desc: NGS share of carries against eight or more defenders in the box.

metrics.label: Carries
metrics.desc: Designed runs.

metrics.label: Rushing yards
metrics.desc: Rushing yards.

metrics.label: Rushing TD
metrics.desc: Rushing touchdowns.

metrics.label: EPA / target
metrics.desc: EPA per target (the receiver's share of the play).

metrics.label: Target share
metrics.desc: Targets per team pass attempt in the player's games.

metrics.label: Targets
metrics.desc: Targets.

metrics.label: Receptions
metrics.desc: Receptions.

metrics.label: Receiving yards
metrics.desc: Receiving yards.

metrics.label: Receiving EPA
metrics.desc: EPA summed over targets.

metrics.label: Air-yards share
metrics.desc: Share of the team's intended air yards in the player's games.

metrics.label: WOPR
metrics.desc: Weighted opportunity rating: 1.5 target share + 0.7 air-yards share.

metrics.label: Catch rate
metrics.desc: Receptions per target.

metrics.label: Catch rate over expected
metrics.desc: Receptions minus expected receptions (completion model) per target.

metrics.label: Drop rate
metrics.desc: FTN drops per catchable target (2022 onward).

metrics.label: Contested catch rate
metrics.desc: FTN contested targets caught (2022 onward).

metrics.label: YAC / reception
metrics.desc: Yards after catch per reception.

metrics.label: YAC over expected
metrics.desc: Yards after catch minus expected YAC per reception (our xYAC; nflfastR's xYAC otherwise).

metrics.label: Separation
metrics.desc: NGS average separation at the catch or incompletion (yards).

metrics.label: Cushion
metrics.desc: NGS average cushion at the snap (yards).

metrics.label: Yards / team attempt
metrics.desc: Receiving yards per team pass attempt in the player's games (a route-free YPRR proxy).

metrics.label: Receiving TD
metrics.desc: Receiving touchdowns.

metrics.label: FG over expected
metrics.desc: Field goals made minus expected (our make-probability model by distance and conditions).

metrics.label: FG over expected / attempt
metrics.desc: Field goals made minus expected per attempt (the rate behind FG over expected; the percentile basis).

metrics.label: Points over expected
metrics.desc: 3 x FG over expected + extra points over expected.

metrics.label: FG %
metrics.desc: Field goals made per attempt.

metrics.label: 50+ made
metrics.desc: Field goals of 50+ yards made.
Field goals of 50+ yards made per attempt.

metrics.label: Average attempt
metrics.desc: Average field-goal attempt distance.

metrics.label: XP %
metrics.desc: Extra points made per attempt.

metrics.label: FG attempts
metrics.desc: Field-goal attempts.

metrics.label: FG made
metrics.desc: Field goals made.

metrics.label: EPA / punt
metrics.desc: EPA per punt for the punting team.

metrics.label: Net average
metrics.desc: Gross distance less return yards and 20 yards per touchback.

metrics.label: Gross average
metrics.desc: Average punt distance.

metrics.label: Inside 20
metrics.desc: Punts downed or returned inside the 20.

metrics.label: Touchback rate
metrics.desc: Touchbacks per punt.

metrics.label: Net over expected
metrics.desc: Opponent field position over expected per punt, in yards (our punt model by launch spot).

metrics.label: Punting EPA
metrics.desc: EPA summed over punts for the punting team.

metrics.label: Punts
metrics.desc: Punts.

metrics.label: Splash EPA
metrics.desc: EPA prevented on plays the player made (sack, interception, forced fumble, pass defensed, tackle for loss), shared among the credited players. Individual defensive value is limited by the data.

metrics.label: Splash plays / game
metrics.desc: Sacks, interceptions, forced fumbles, passes defensed and tackles for loss per game.

metrics.label: Sacks
metrics.desc: Sacks (half sacks count 0.5).

metrics.label: QB hits
metrics.desc: QB hits.

metrics.label: Sacks + hits / game
metrics.desc: Sacks and QB hits per game.

metrics.label: Tackles for loss
metrics.desc: Tackles for loss.

metrics.label: Tackles
metrics.desc: Solo and assisted tackles, special teams included (the official count).

metrics.label: Passes defensed
metrics.desc: Passes defensed.

metrics.label: Forced fumbles
metrics.desc: Forced fumbles.

metrics.label: Sacks / game
metrics.desc: Sacks per game (half sacks count 0.5).

metrics.label: TFL / game
metrics.desc: Tackles for loss per game.

metrics.label: Tackles / game
metrics.desc: Solo and assisted tackles per game, special teams included.

metrics.label: Passes defensed / game
metrics.desc: Passes defensed per game.

metrics.label: Interceptions / game
metrics.desc: Interceptions per game.

metrics.label: Forced fumbles / game
metrics.desc: Forced fumbles per game.

metrics.label: Defensive snaps
metrics.desc: Scrimmage snaps on the field on defence (nflverse participation, 2016-2025; none for the current season).

team_metrics.label: Team rating
team_metrics.desc: Points per game better than an average team on a neutral field (our team strength; our EPA rating when it is not available).

team_metrics.label: Offence rating
team_metrics.desc: Offensive points per game over average.

team_metrics.label: Defence rating
team_metrics.desc: Defensive points per game over average (positive = better).

team_metrics.label: Offence EPA / play
team_metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play (offence).

team_metrics.label: Defence EPA / play
team_metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play allowed.

team_metrics.label: Pass offence EPA
team_metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per dropback.

team_metrics.label: Rush offence EPA
team_metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per designed run.

team_metrics.label: Pass defence EPA
team_metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per dropback allowed.

team_metrics.label: Rush defence EPA
team_metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per designed run allowed.

team_metrics.label: Special teams EPA / game
team_metrics.desc: EPA per game on kicks, punts and returns (net of the opponent's).

team_metrics.label: Offence success
team_metrics.desc: Share of plays with positive EPA.

team_metrics.label: Defence success allowed
team_metrics.desc: Share of opponent plays with positive EPA.

team_metrics.label: PROE
team_metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected (nflfastR xpass), all plays.

team_metrics.label: PROE (neutral)
team_metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected on early downs, win probability 20-80 %, outside the last two minutes of a half.

team_metrics.label: PROE (3rd down)
team_metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected on third down.

team_metrics.label: PROE (red zone)
team_metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected inside the opponent's 20.

team_metrics.label: PROE (leading 8+)
team_metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected when leading by 8 or more.

team_metrics.label: PROE (trailing 8+)
team_metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected when trailing by 8 or more.

team_metrics.label: Shotgun rate
team_metrics.desc: Share of scrimmage plays from shotgun.

team_metrics.label: No-huddle rate
team_metrics.desc: Share of plays without a huddle.

team_metrics.label: Play-action rate
team_metrics.desc: Play action per dropback (FTN, 2022 onward).

team_metrics.label: RPO rate
team_metrics.desc: Run-pass options per scrimmage play (FTN, 2022 onward).

team_metrics.label: Motion rate
team_metrics.desc: Pre-snap motion per scrimmage play (FTN, 2022 onward).

team_metrics.label: Screen rate
team_metrics.desc: Screens per pass attempt (FTN, 2022 onward).

team_metrics.label: Blitz rate
team_metrics.desc: Dropbacks against five or more rushers or any blitzer (FTN, 2022 onward).

team_metrics.label: Box count
team_metrics.desc: Average defenders in the box (FTN 2022 onward; participation before).

team_metrics.label: Man coverage rate
team_metrics.desc: Man coverage per dropback (participation, 2016-2025).

team_metrics.label: Pressure rate allowed
team_metrics.desc: Share of dropbacks under pressure (our pressure model: participation 2016-2025, modelled otherwise).

team_metrics.label: Pressure rate (defence)
team_metrics.desc: Share of opponent dropbacks pressured.

team_metrics.label: Early-down pass EPA
team_metrics.desc: EPA per dropback on first and second down (offence, raw).

team_metrics.label: Early-down pass EPA allowed
team_metrics.desc: EPA per dropback allowed on first and second down (defence, raw).

team_metrics.label: Early-down pass rate
team_metrics.desc: Share of first- and second-down plays that are dropbacks.

team_metrics.label: Sack rate (defence)
team_metrics.desc: Sacks per opponent dropback: the pass rush when no pressure data is available.

team_metrics.label: Sack rate allowed
team_metrics.desc: Sacks taken per dropback: pass protection (and the quarterback's part in it).

team_metrics.label: Seconds / play (neutral)
team_metrics.desc: Seconds between consecutive offensive snaps in neutral situations (lower = faster).

team_metrics.label: Seconds / play
team_metrics.desc: Seconds between consecutive offensive snaps.

team_metrics.label: Plays / game
team_metrics.desc: Offensive scrimmage plays per game.

team_metrics.label: 4th-down go rate
team_metrics.desc: Share of fourth downs (not end-of-half kneel / desperation) where the offence went for it.

team_metrics.label: Go when advised
team_metrics.desc: Share of fourth downs our model says to go for where the team went.

team_metrics.label: WP lost on 4th downs
team_metrics.desc: Win probability given up against the model's recommendation, summed over the season's fourth downs.
